verdict.rationale: mise's registry backends (aqua, github, npm, pipx, cargo, go, vfox, asdf-compatible plugins, Homebrew) give access to a huge range of installable tools, and community reviews corroborate this breadth ('access to almost all programs available on GitHub', 'many more package sources including pipx, go and cargo'). missing for 10: independent quantitative comparison of registry size vs competitors (e.g., Homebrew/asdf), and any evidence of gaps or missing packages reported by users.
